## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (or the CI checks are green)
- [ ] Behaviour is covered by tests that describe what the caller observes
- [ ] UI text exists in English and German and uses the [glossary](../doc/glossary.md)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, configuration or the public API changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, databases or uploads in the diff
- [ ] Commit subjects are conventional (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...) and carry no AI attribution
- [ ] Targets the right branch (`main`, or the open `release/x.y.z` branch)
